decisions.reason: As a visible multi-item line close to the firm's core natural facial-care range, management is likely to defend the prior investment and public commitment and interpret any mixed results as still temporary.

The hyaluronic serum fits the established offer and, having already remained through 2024 in a growing market, is likely to be retained because sunk development effort and range coherence support continued commitment.
Although less prominently presented, the cleansing milk is still close to the core business, so management would probably persist with it and justify another year rather than admit a mistaken launch.
Because the cleansing oil was only launched in 2024 and sits squarely within the existing skincare portfolio, management is likely to see it as too early to abandon and keep backing it for now.
